# The Warrior line

*Generated by `scen/render_docs.py` from the code; do not edit by hand. Run `python3 scen/render_docs.py` after changing the code.*

Every hero is currently a Warrior. A hero sheet lasts the hero's whole career: it is printed once, at the hero's starting
level (low 1, mid 3, high 5, from the code's band), and filled in by hand as the hero plays. The seed decides the path
taken by a mid or high hero and the effects every hero draws.

## Classes

| Class | Levels | Path | STR | DEX | INT | WIS | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Warrior | 1-2 | start | +2 | 0 | −1 | 0 | A decent fighter with a balance between defense and attack. |
| Knight | 3-4 | from Warrior | +2 | −1 | 0 | +1 | An armored soldier who wins by outlasting. |
| Barbarian | 3-4 | from Warrior | +2 | +1 | −1 | 0 | A wild fighter whose fury grows with every misstep. |
| Paladin | 5-6 | from Knight | +2 | −1 | 0 | +2 | A holy knight whose defense becomes power. |
| Cavalier | 5-6 | from Knight | +2 | +1 | 0 | 0 | A mounted knight who strikes in charges. |
| Berserker | 5-6 | from Barbarian | +2 | +2 | −1 | 0 | Most dangerous when nearly beaten. |
| Beastkin | 5-6 | from Barbarian | +1 | +2 | −1 | +1 | Hunts weak points with a beast at its side. |

Stats are added to map rolls (d6 + stat; 4 or more succeeds). A new class's stats replace the old ones.
WIS also sets the number of **adjustments** per scenario: 3 + WIS.

## Abilities

### Warrior (every hero)

| Ability | From level | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Heavy Blows | 1 | Columns A and I deal 3 per square. |
| Shield | 1 | +1 guard every round. |
| Riposte | 1 | After the enemy turn, 1 damage per 4 leftover guard, up to 2. |
| Heavy Blows II | 2 | From row 6 up, every damage column deals +1 per square (notched squares). |

### Path abilities

Each path class adds one ability when chosen and ranks it up (or adds a second) at the next level.

| Class | Level | Ability | Rule (as printed) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Knight | 3 | Hold the Line | After the enemy turn: Riposte, or carry half your leftover guard into next round. |
| Knight | 4 | (rank-up) | Carry all of it. |
| Barbarian | 3 | Rage | Each fumble fills a Rage box. Spend all 3 to re-roll a bust or fumble. |
| Barbarian | 4 | Fury | At full Rage, a fumble’s counter can hit the enemy instead (Rage empties). |
| Paladin | 5 | Oath | Leftover guard: 1 damage or 1 healing per 3, up to 5. |
| Paladin | 6 | Radiant Aura | Immune to Daze, Pin, Venom. Oath does both, 1 per 4, up to 4 each. |
| Cavalier | 5 | Charge | First attack, every 3rd, and after a kill: an extra lance runner starts on row 3; enemies skip that round. |
| Cavalier | 6 | Trample | Overkill hits another enemy. Lance squares +1. |
| Berserker | 5 | Bloodlust | At 18 HP or less, a matching pair (like 3+3) moves 2. |
| Berserker | 6 | Unstoppable | First fumble each fight: take the counter, move 1 wild, keep rolling. |
| Beastkin | 5 | Claws | Weak points are 1 row lower. A weak-point hit: 4 free steps, ×3 that column. |
| Beastkin | 6 | Pack | On 1-1 or 6-6 your beast climbs 1, below the danger line. Its squares deal double. |

### Exact numbers

The simulator's values (from `engine2.py`), which the printed wording rounds off:

- **Hold the Line** (Knight): after the enemy turn, choose Riposte or carry half your leftover guard into next round; level 4 carries all of it.
- **Rage / Fury** (Barbarian): each fumble fills a Rage box (3 boxes). Spend all 3 to re-roll a bust or fumble. Fury (level 4): at full Rage and **20 HP or less**, a fumble's counter hits the enemy instead.
- **Reserve runner** (level 4, both branches): once per fight, when a roll would bust, a 4th runner comes in and the dice are used again.
- **Oath** (Paladin): leftover guard becomes 1 damage or 1 healing per **3**, up to **5**, chosen each round.
- **Radiant Aura** (Paladin 6): immune to Daze, Pin and Venom; leftover guard both damages and heals, 1 per **4**, up to **4** each.
- **Charge** (Cavalier): an extra lance runner starts on row 3 on the first attack of a fight, every 3rd attack and the attack after a kill; enemies are knocked back and skip that round.
- **Trample** (Cavalier 6): overkill damage carries to another enemy; the lance runner's squares deal +1.
- **Bloodlust** (Berserker): at **18 HP or less**, a matching pair (like 3+3) moves two squares.
- **Unstoppable** (Berserker 6): the first fumble each fight costs the counter, then becomes a wild step and the attack continues.
- **Claws** (Beastkin): every enemy's weak point is **1** row lower; a weak-point hit gives **4** free steps and triples that column.
- **Pack** (Beastkin 6): on a 1-1 or 6-6 wild, the beast runner also pounces: it climbs one square (up to the danger line) and its squares deal double.

## Attack grid

Nine columns, numbered 3-11 (the pair totals) and lettered A-I. Columns A and I deal 3 per square (Heavy Blows), B, C, G
and H deal 1, and D, E and F give 2 guard. The grid starts at 9 rows; rows 10-11 unlock at level 3 and rows 12-13 at
level 5, so a column is full at row 9, 11 or 13. Grid squares are 12.2 mm so a die fits.

| Row | A (3) | B (4) | C (5) | D (6) | E (7) | F (8) | G (9) | H (10) | I (11) | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **13** | · | · | · | L | M | L | · | · | · | level 5 |
| **12** | · | · | L · |  | R |  | L · | · | · | level 5 |
| **11** | · | R · | · | M |  | M | · | R · | · | level 3 |
| **10** | L · | · | R · |  | R |  | R · | · | L · | level 3 |
| **9** | L · | L · | · |  | bolt |  | · | L · | L · |  |
| **8** | · | · | · | bolt | R | bolt | · | · | · |  |
| **7** | · | · | R · | +1 |  | +1 | R · | · | · |  |
| **6** | · | · | bolt · |  | +1 |  | bolt · | · | · |  |
| **5** |  | bolt |  | U | U | U |  | bolt |  | level-6 danger line below |
| **4** | R |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | R | danger line below this row |
| **3** | bolt |  |  | +1 |  | +1 |  |  | bolt |  |
| **2** |  | U |  | C | C | C |  | U |  |  |
| **1** |  |  |  |  | +1 |  |  |  |  |  |

Key: **C U R L M** effect tiles (common, uncommon, rare, legendary, mythic); **+1** a square that deals 1 extra damage and
gives no guard; **bolt** a Surge square (the first time a column reaches it in an attack, take one free step);
**·** a Heavy Blows II square (+1 damage from level 2: every damage column from row 6 up).

**Danger line:** once any runner is on row 4 or higher (row 5 from level 6), three or four of a kind on a roll is a fumble.

## Effects

Reaching an effect tile lets you use one of your effects of that rarity. Each hero draws effects per rarity with a d6:
1 gives one, 2-5 two, 6 three, but **only one rarity may keep three** (if several roll a 6, one is picked at random by the
seed and the rest get two). Heroes have 5-11 effects. Mythic tiles are on rows 10-13 only.

### Common (C)

| Effect | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Extra Attack | (once) +1 damage. |
| Brace | (once) +3 guard this round if any enemy’s next attack is heavy. |
| Mark | (once) +1 damage on your next attack. |

### Uncommon (U)

| Effect | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Poison I | (once) Your target takes 1 damage per round for 2 rounds. |
| Ranged | (once) 2 damage to any enemy, ignoring Bodyguard (1 if it’s the only enemy). |
| Pickpocket | (once) Gain gold equal to your top column, and +1 damage. |
| Cleave | (once) Another enemy takes a third of your top column, rounded down. |
| Leech | (once per fight) Heal a fifth of your top column, rounded down. |
| Disarm | For its next 2 turns, your target’s heavy attacks become its first listed attack. |

### Rare (R)

| Effect | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Poison II | Your target takes 2 damage per round for 4 rounds. |
| Sleep | Your target skips its next attack; the one after is halved. |
| Weaken | Your target’s attacks deal 3 less for the rest of the fight. |
| Momentum | Your next attack deals a third of your top column extra, rounded up. |

### Legendary (L)

| Effect | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Critical Hit | Your top column counts five times. |
| Chain | Another enemy takes twice your top column. |
| Execute | Defeat an enemy at half its HP or less, or at 8 or less; otherwise 15 damage. |
| Encore | Take another full attack now; if this one fumbled, ignore the fumble. |

### Mythic (M)

| Effect | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Meteor | Every enemy takes your top column ×4. |
| Time Stop | When your attack ends, roll d6 more times (no fumbles); enemies skip a round. |
| Overdrive | Every filled square deals +2 this attack. |
| Phoenix | Once per scenario, at 0 HP return at 10 HP instead. |
| Godslayer | Defeat a minion or miniboss outright; a boss takes 25. |
| Echo | This attack happens again next turn, with your next attack. |

**Top column** means your highest-damage column this attack. **(once)** effects can be used once per attack.

## Pockets

Instead of using an effect right away, write its rarity in your pocket (one at a time). On any later turn, erase it and use
one of your effects of that rarity. A pocketed effect keeps until used, across fights and scenarios. The sheet shows one
pocket and three locked slots for future upgrades (a **Pocket upgrade** from a chest or shop adds one).

## The rest of the sheet

- **HP 50**, **8 potion slots** (drink any time, +5 HP) and a **gold** box. Inventory carries over between scenarios.
- **Level track** 1-6 in three bands (low, mid, high). Win a scenario and complete 3 of its 5 objectives to level up.
- **Adjustments: 3 + WIS** boxes, refreshed each scenario.
- **Tracker:** Rage (3), Reserve, Carried guard, Unstoppable and Phoenix, for the abilities and effects that need counting.
